result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): Both answers find the same main problems: too many families, Lobster as the body font at 13px with tight leading, hairline weights, and the @import chain, excess weights and display=block. Both also suggest a friendly Nunito-based fix. B is better because it explicitly points out the missing generic fallbacks and adds an accurate point about faux bold in Lobster. A uses a fallback stack in its sketch but never names the missing fallbacks as a problem. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers cover the main problems well and land on a similar Nunito fix. A is the only one that says outright that most families have no generic fallback, and it adds the faux-bold point about Lobster. B miscounts at one point ('five font families' followed by a list of six) and never flags the missing fallbacks, though it does usefully note the #666 contrast and the inconsistent heading hierarchy.
